The clinical presentation of an erythematous, edematous, pebbly plaque on the dorsal hand combined with your history of outdoor activities and lack of other systemic symptoms is highly characteristic of allergic contact dermatitis, most commonly caused by exposure to plants like poison ivy or oak.
